svg.text: Workflow Lab — Prototype Spec (Tool = code, Graph = YAML, Canvas executes)

4 primitives: TOOL = code(inputs,ctx)->outputs · REGISTRY = map of tools · GRAPH = typed DAG (in-memory) saved as YAML · RUNNER executes it. Key split: REPRESENTATION (canvas/YAML, for viewing) is separate from STEPS (the actual actions that run).
Add a tool = add a function.
REPRESENTATION = canvas nodes + YAML + ui:{x,y} + previews. Exists for VIEWER EASE. Never executes.
STEPS = the tool.run() actions that actually happen (calls, slicing, downloads). The runner only runs STEPS.
A SINK (preview/download) is a STEP with outputs:[] -- it consumes a value and surfaces it to the REPRESENTATION
layer (inspector/file). 'sink' is terminal-only: NOT a connectable value type, nothing wires out of it.
type ImageValue = { bytes: Uint8Array, mimeType: string,
Worker returns bytes. slice / preview / download all speak
ImageValue -> identical in browser + node. NOT a URL/DOM node.
input set by BOTH with+needs · >1 binding
RUN-TIME: full readiness on the exec set.
No execution cache. BUT each node keeps its LAST run
outputs in memory (a retained artifact, not a cache).
• FREEZE/PIN an output -> downstream reads the frozen
ImageValue. Mechanically: swap the upstream edge for
a const.image holding the retained value.
-> change slice rows/cols and RE-SLICE the SAME sheet
• editing a node marks its (+downstream) results STALE.
runGraph(graph, registry, { to?, signal, onNode }) -> { nodes: { id: { status, outputs, error } } }
EXECUTION SET: {to} -> target + its ancestor closure (each shared ancestor once). no {to} -> all sinks + ancestors.
ORDER: topo-sort, sequential. 'Run to here' re-runs the closure every time (unless an ancestor is FROZEN).
FAILURE: a failed node -> its descendants = 'blocked'; independent branches continue. Draft/disconnected
nodes NOT in the exec set don't block a valid branch. default timeout + normalized errors in the runner.
onNode event: { id, status: pending|running|succeeded|failed|blocked|cancelled, outputs?, error? }
error = { kind: auth|timeout|network|tool|validation, message, httpStatus? }. (auth kind covers worker token expiry.)
canvas maps results onto nodes by id + output name (multi-output -> inspector output selector).
id, name, tags: string[], sampleImage?: url
vars: [{ name, type, required, default }] // FULL schema
Select -> snapshot BOTH template AND the vars schema into the node
(not just values). vars schema persists in YAML (with.varsSchema).
Inspector renders typed editable fields from it; validate unresolved
If a var input is wired, it overrides the literal. Editing template
re-derives var names; orphaned values dropped.

DEFERRED: versioning/immutability · caching/idempotency · adapters · secrets/auth per tool · durable backend · full eval (RunRecord later) · headless CLI · sink universal-preview. CUT: shared registry/preset storage abstraction; pick IndexedDB OR OPFS.
